description: This circular walk climbs to Scarr and Kanturk mountains in the Wicklow Mountains. The mountains are located on the western side of Lough Dan, a large, ribbon-like lake known for its rugged and unspoiled beauty. From the summits, you can enjoy stunning panoramic views of the lake below and the surrounding rugged landscape, including the neighbouring peaks of Tonelagee Walk and Djouce. The trail itself is a challenging hike with a consistent climb, taking you over open mountain terrain. While not as crowded as some of the more well-known Wicklow hikes, this route is a great choice for those looking to experience the wilder side of the mountains.
